notes.title: Add SONG RANGE, MIX and FLOW
notes.text: Add SONG RANGE, MIX and FLOW: per-row transpose, offset, length, mutes, tempo, counted backward loops and jumps. STOP restores the original tempo, mutes and track options. Offset follows source notes, locks, slides and swing together.

notes.title: Add SONG FILE with confirmed
notes.text: Add SONG FILE with confirmed NEW SONG and reloadable AFTER HOURS demo. The eight-row arrangement uses kick, snare, hats, bass, melody, locks and phaser; built-in phrases occupy no user slots. Saved demo arrangements retain their built-in source references.

notes.title: Preserve MNM3–MNM7 projects and version-one/two/three
notes.text: Preserve MNM3–MNM7 projects and version-one/two/three pattern payloads with frozen readers. MNM8 projects occupy 3648 bytes; version-four patterns occupy 3034 bytes.

notes.title: Make SELECT navigate all pages
notes.text: Make SELECT navigate all pages in the current family, including appended performance and SONG pages.

notes.title: Distinguish a committed project with
notes.text: Distinguish a committed project with a failed startup-bank marker as SAVED; BOOT ERROR. Add read-only USB storage diagnostics with the failing operation, address, error and flash status; no protection flags are changed.

notes.title: Verify all legacy banks through
notes.text: Verify all legacy banks through simulated reboot, interrupted writes and write protection; keep the previous committed data on failed saves.

notes.title: Publish the matching 1.0 simulator
notes.text: Publish the matching 1.0 simulator and installer; remove the roadmap from the project website.
